tagline: 24/7 Emergency Storm Leak & Full Replacement Specialists

HIGH_EMERGENCY.condition: Active water intrusion inside living quarters, tree on roof, or collapsed drywall
HIGH_EMERGENCY.action: Immediate dispatch alert to on-call project manager, offer live transfer, and send urgent WhatsApp link to upload photo for immediate crew routing.

STANDARD_INSPECTION.condition: Missing shingles, age inspection, minor wear, routine quote, insurance claim review
STANDARD_INSPECTION.action: Book 15-minute on-site assessment slot on calendar, capture address, request photo via WhatsApp.

services.name: Full Architectural Shingle / Metal Roof Replacement

qualificationQuestions: Are you the homeowner or property manager?
What is the street address of the property?
Is there water actively leaking into the home right now?
Approximately how old is the current roof, and have you filed an insurance claim?

faq.q: Do you work with home insurance companies?
faq.a: Yes! We work directly with State Farm, Allstate, Travelers, Liberty Mutual, and all major carriers to handle your storm/hail claim.

faq.q: How quickly can someone arrive for an active emergency leak?
faq.a: Our emergency tarping crew can typically be on-site within 60 to 90 minutes across our metro service area.

faq.q: Are your roofers licensed and insured?
faq.a: We carry $2M commercial general liability insurance and are GAF Master Elite certified with full manufacturer warranties.
